name: block-zone-gridpoint
full_name: Deformable-Block Zone and Gridpoint FISH Intrinsics
description: Pointer-based FISH access to the continuum inside deformable blocks — zones (finite-volume elements) and their gridpoints. Use for scripted stress/strain probes and convergence checks.

notes: block.zone.containing(pos) finds the zone enclosing a point.
'block.zone.model' / 'block.zone.prop' read the assigned zone constitutive model and its properties.
See the 'constitutive-models' reference for property keywords.
block.gp.force.unbal is the per-gridpoint unbalanced force used for convergence.

verification: Live-verified 2026-08-14 against 3DEC 9.7.47 (full 'fish list intrinsics' dump): the gridpoint family lives under block.gp.* - the block.gridpoint.* names this file previously carried DO NOT EXIST (renamed here); all block.* core and block.zone.* names confirmed present. Live gp family is much richer (accel/force.app/force.reaction/temp/ratio/... families).
